description: Download a file from an http(s) URL into the workspace. The body is streamed to disk with a hard byte ceiling. Same allowlist as `http_request`. Returns the saved path, bytes written, content-type, and SHA-256 of the file.
name: curl

dest_path.description: Destination path relative to the downloads root inside the workspace. No '..' or absolute paths. If omitted, the filename is inferred from the URL.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL of the file to download
